title: Maximum decode with MTP on around 64K context
caption: Around 64K on P1, ACO reached 79.69 tokens/s, GPU reached 80.70, and CPU reached 17.68.

title: Maximum decode with MTP on across prompt types
caption: At 250K filled context, ACO measured 61.13, 48.83, and 55.35 tokens/s on P1, P2, and P3, compared with CPU at 7.21, 5.49, and 6.50.

title: Maximum decode with MTP on for P1 Python merge
caption: ACO measured 102.48 tokens/s at 6K context and 61.23 tokens/s near full 256K context on P1.

title: Maximum decode with MTP on for P3 Bash watcher
caption: ACO measured 92.93 tokens/s at 6K context and 55.35 tokens/s at 250K filled context on P3.

title: Maximum decode with MTP on at 250K filled context
caption: At 256,000 occupied tokens, ACO measured 61.13, 48.83, and 55.35 tokens/s across P1, P2, and P3.

title: Maximum decode by CPU MTP placement
caption: Around 64K on P1, CPU + GPU MTP measured 17.68 tokens/s and master CPU + MTP measured 15.12, a 16.9% gain.

title: Maximum decode with MTP off across prompt types
caption: At 250K filled context, ACO measured 37.51, 37.57, and 37.45 tokens/s on P1, P2, and P3.

title: Maximum ACO decode with MTP on and off
caption: At 250K filled context on P1, ACO measured 61.13 tokens/s with MTP on and 37.51 tokens/s with MTP off.

title: Backend prefill with MTP on across context lengths
caption: With MTP on, ACO ingested fresh repository chunks at 1,402 backend tokens/s on the first 8K append and 614 tokens/s near full 256K context.

title: Maximum decode with MTP on for P2 mmap vs read
caption: ACO measured 82.01 tokens/s at 6K context and 48.83 tokens/s at 250K filled context on P2.
